title: Worked Cases: Application Fee Add-Back in the Mortgage Loan File Zero-Tolerance Cure
content:
**Rule.** In the zero-tolerance cure on a Mortgage Loan File, where an application fee collection entry is on the fee ledger, whatever its amount (a 0.00 collection included), and it has not been refunded, the difference between the program's application fee and the amount collected is added back, which is nothing when the full program fee was collected; where the collection has been refunded in full, the program's application fee is added back; where no application fee collection is on the ledger, as for a program that charges no application fee, nothing is added back.

The facts come from the file's fee ledger — the application fee collection entry and any refund of it (a denial or improper-collection refund, or a withdrawal refund) — and the program's application fee from the Larkspur program fee schedule.

## Worked cases (hypothetical, program application fee of 450.00 USD)

| Fee ledger | Added back |
|---|---|
| collection of 225.00 USD, not refunded | 450.00 less 225.00, which is 225.00 USD |
| collection of 337.50 USD, not refunded | 112.50 USD |
| collection of 0.00 USD, not refunded | 450.00 USD |
| collection of 450.00 USD, not refunded | nothing — the full program fee was collected |
| collection of 450.00 USD, refunded in full | 450.00 USD |
| no application fee collection | nothing |

Under a program that charges no application fee no collection is on the ledger, so nothing is added back.
